facts.documented: Workflow settings exposes Timeout Workflow / Timeout After; Cloud enforces a plan maximum.
Public comparison lists Starter 5 minutes, Pro 40 minutes and Enterprise 40 minutes. Trial lists 180 seconds.
Paid-plan sub-workflow calls through Execute Sub-workflow do not count separately; only the top-level parent execution counts.
Custom variables are documented for Cloud Pro and Enterprise. Owners/admins create them. Project scope is documented from n8n 1.118.0.
Owners/admins can install verified nodes from the canvas node panel. Cloud owner controls verified-node visibility in Cloud Admin.
Apify documents its @apify/n8n-nodes-apify integration and Cloud installation through the canvas registry; verified-node visibility must be enabled.
Execute Query supports $1/$2 placeholders and Options > Query Parameters, with fixed or expression-provided values.

facts.topic: Queue mode versus ordinary Cloud concurrency
facts.documented: Cloud queue mode is documented as Enterprise-only and enabled through n8n. Regular-mode concurrency queues do not establish queue-mode entitlement.
